0.title: [2026] REALM-CA 1
0.ratio: Appeal dismissed unanimously. The s. 8/s. 5 sequencing complaint is not made out; s. 8 cannot be applied without implicitly applying s. 5, so the complaint describes a structural impossibility. REALM-PC 1 confirmed good law.

1.title: [2026] REALM-CA 2
1.ratio: VOID AB INITIO: heard by an even bench of four (s. 18). Set aside by [2026] REALM-SC 4, which re-determined the substance. Retained for the record only; nothing binds.

2.title: [2026] REALM-PC 1
2.ratio: A governance system is fit for alpha release where the core legal model is coherent, statute + procedure + founding caselaw are committed, constitutional enforcement is in place, and known gaps are disclosed; convenience tooling is not a prerequisite for alpha; deterministic citation numbering is a necessary condition for v1.

3.title: [2026] REALM-PC 10
3.ratio: On the Standing Committee's reference: the realm has a delegated power (Bill 14) but no instantiated, uniform route to make/amend/repeal/enforce statutory instruments; cure is one SI framework (best as an amendment to Bill 14) adding a binding-regulation estate tier, an amend procedure, a Bill 16 citation slot and a Bill 13 enforcement receiver, plus short per-Act enabling clauses. Completes rather than amends the settlement (no leapfrog). The Committee's default act is to make/amend SIs; fresh statutes are exceptional.

4.title: [2026] REALM-PC 11
4.ratio: The SI citation form is Form C (HYBRID): a flat global annual ordinal [YEAR] REALM-SI N minted by the unchanged deterministic engine on one REALM-SI code, always shown with a derived, recital-extracted parent tag (under Bill NN); the enabling power is always recited in full (recitals govern, the tag is a derived pointer); an amending SI is a fresh flat SI with its own tag, the amend link a register pointer; SI status vocab = made/in-force/amended/revoked/spent. Completes the scheme (no leapfrog).

5.title: [2026] REALM-PC 12
5.ratio: Lexby (CASE-LAW s. 3) holds NO authority to draft instruments of law or author judgments on its own account; such text is void AS AN INSTRUMENT from issue (counsel, not the organ or the bench) but admissible as a void first draft leapfrogging to the Committee's second-draft stage; adoption by the proper organ (Committee vote + Royal Assent; or a counted bench) is constitutive and CURES the origin defect, so already-adopted text stands (entry-by-entry, non-infectious, conforming [2026] REALM-SC 7); engineering remains Lexby's under s. 3, the test being the SOURCE OF THE ARTEFACT'S FORCE (function vs promulgation by an organ). FOUNDATIONAL; escalation to the full Supreme Court recommended.

6.title: [2026] REALM-PC 13
6.ratio: On the MDS reference of five agent-security forks: the secure default and the operable default are one construction - a fail-closed control on the secure default carrying an audited non-standing break-glass within the closed three-mechanism primitive (Bill 13 s.6, s.7(2)), under capability-is-not-authority (Bill 18 s.3) and never-brick (Bill 13 s.7(2); Bill 21 s.13). Held: (1) central closed trust-tier floor, agent tighten-only, no self-elevation on ingested instruction (Bill 18 s.3(2)); (2) egress fail-closed to an allowlist WITH an audited break-glass, a break-glass-less brick void as a falling-below (Bill 13 s.7(2)); (3) MDS-held AUDITED DELEGATION signing with a revocable trust root, single-key rejected as unbounded blast-radius and realm-bricking (REALM-SI 1 s.7(2); Bill 13 s.7(2)); (4) kernel/infra compromise owned by REALM-SI 1 (s.6(4), s.9(4)), this SI cross-references not carves out (read-together-without-overlap REALM-SI 4 s.2(3); one-home CASE-LAW s.12, REALM-PC 8); (5) reversible sensitive acts log DECISION + PROVENANCE not full chain-of-thought (Bill 13 s.8; reversible calibration Bill 18 s.7(4); anti-bloat CASE-LAW s.12; draft-doctrine REALM-SC 8 / REALM-PC 12). Unanimous (3-0). No fork climbs.

7.title: [2026] REALM-PC 14
7.ratio: County Court formation is a SUBSTANCE rule, not a file-presence rule: a repo is validly constituted as a local hearing-centre (s. 22(1)) by (a) a genuine seated jurisdiction-repo of the one judiciary (s. 14, s. 22), (b) a tracked record of system data only with no personal/operational facts (Bill 27 s. 7; Bill 22), and (c) Bill 20 integrity-chain conformance. The .gitignore is the ORDINARY, presumptive EVIDENCE and MECHANISM of the (b) boundary where private data is held, not the constitutive act: Bill 27 s. 8(4) makes it the sign from which data-presence is PRESUMED, so it is probative not operative; it is neither necessary (a no-private-data repo needs none) nor sufficient (an empty ignore constitutes nothing); a constitutive-.gitignore rule is form-over-substance, void under s. 22(4). The gate checks the substance, not the filename. Unanimous 3-0; does not climb.

8.title: [2026] REALM-PC 15
8.ratio: On the Founder's VJS self-classification reference: the super-repo is the realm-as-state, not a County Court (s. 22(3); REALM-SC 6; REALM-PC 14 seat condition fails); the central Privy Council (REALM-PC) is a DISTINCT central constitutional/governance first-instance court, the s. 10 First-Instance tier sitting CENTRALLY for realm matters at the MoJ/realm level, not 'the County Court at the super-repo' and no new tier/seat/apex (s. 22(2)); s. 22 distributed only the PROJECT first-instance seat across jurisdiction-repos (s. 22(1)) and never displaced the realm's own central first instance; 'adds no seat' CONSERVES the s. 10 tier, it does not un-seat it; the citation signature (central REALM-* series, not CC-<repo>) is substance, not label (REALM-PC 14 satisfied, not offended); already given effect by s. 22 read with s. 10/s. 13 + the Bill 16 scheme, so no conforming note is needed and this stands as declaratory precedent; forward doc-conformance directed (s. 6). Unanimous 3-0; does not climb.

9.title: [2026] REALM-PC 16
9.ratio: The public VJS release sequence was lawful: completed outward public acts were authorised, system-data-only, backed by private branch and clean-history preview, and verified by citator/lodge/tests/scans; blocked attempts to replace protected master caused no publication and were restorative events, the gate parser defect being fixed before the completed public push; publishing public-vjs-canonical-preview and setting it as default lawfully avoided rewriting protected history; README restoration was lawful conformance to REALM-PC 3. Prospectively, REALM-SI 7 requires a release warrant before every public super-repo push and a Privy Council post-push review after it.

12.ratio: A deterministic, token-free retrieval index over the committed markdown is a permitted screening device under s. 12 on three cumulative conditions (index-not-replacement; adoption gated on a pre-stated measured trigger and presently FORBIDDEN; cheaper token-free intermediates exhausted first). Until the gate trips the s. 8 duty is to monitor and report, not build.

13.title: [2026] REALM-PC 5
13.ratio: The "framework-seeding" inclusion doctrine; held an unmoored extension (s. 17) and no part of the law. Superseded by [2026] REALM-SC 4.

14.title: [2026] REALM-PC 6
14.ratio: Harvest only generic, fact-free, provenance-clean method to enhance the harness; never rubric criteria or answers (fast-path application of REALM-SC 4).

15.title: [2026] REALM-PC 7
15.ratio: Two sealed rooms: the agent room never sees the rubric; the marker room may. Admissibility of anonymised scoring and self-marking (fast-path application of REALM-SC 4).

16.title: [2026] REALM-PC 8
16.ratio: One spine, domain DIVISIONS not domain COURTS (affirmed by REALM-SC 5).

17.title: [2026] REALM-PC 9
17.ratio: A Sweet & Maxwell / Restatement-style practitioner treatise capturing the Legal Division's learnings is permitted, provenance-clean, chaptered by capability.

18.title: [2026] REALM-SC 1
18.ratio: Breach is the tort of negligence (duty + graded endeavours + remediation only); the system is a unitary realm of parliamentary sovereignty (one global CASE-LAW, jurisdiction-local case law, one apex court).

19.title: [2026] REALM-SC 2
19.ratio: s. 4 imposes a proactive disclosure obligation: Lexby must raise known material risks to the principal's project even when not asked; silence in the face of a known material risk is breach; remedy under s. 6 is disclosure and restoration. Majority 4:1.

20.title: [2026] REALM-SC 3
20.ratio: Six reforms (VARIED 8:1): leapfrog as reviewable executive routing act; two-sided researched intake as the content of the s. 3 case file; apex-only observer; independent leave-judge; non-adjudicating per-turn watchdog; deterministic pre-commit citation-integrity gate.

21.title: [2026] REALM-SC 4
21.ratio: Every bench must be odd-numbered and its sizes are the total deciding membership; the judgment is authored by one counted member (the synthesiser-on-top pattern abolished); a ruling by an improperly constituted bench is void ab initio. Anti-cheat: only generic, answer-key-free methodology may enter a scored-agent prompt. Enacts s. 18.

22.title: [2026] REALM-SC 5
22.ratio: The realm is one unitary court organised into domain DIVISIONS over one spine, never fractured into domain COURTS owning parallel law/citators/apexes (s. 9); a product advice feature is outside VJS governance (s. 14). Enacts s. 21.

23.title: [2026] REALM-SC 6
23.ratio: The realm may be a super-repo over a Ministry of Justice + operational repos, each repo a local County Court hearing-centre of the one judiciary, while the single Court of Appeal and Supreme Court stay central; the singleness of the apex may never be relaxed; apex enactment is non-delegable. Enacts s. 22.

24.title: [2026] REALM-SC 7
24.ratio: Pre-enactment precedent is judged ENTRY-BY-ENTRY on the deterministic record, never wholesale; Bill 25 s.6(2) and CASE-LAW s.18(5) INTERLOCK (the savings carve out the void, an ordinary Act cannot revive it); s.18(5) is PROSPECTIVE in reach (the entrenchment lock vs s.10 compels it), deep+incurable in quality; the s.18(5) vice is a found fact on a specific bench, never presumed from age and not infectious; a legacy repo owes only restorative, prospective conformance (new matters use the new machinery; mark void only on a found improper bench; integrity-chain stays intact). VARIED 9:0 (leapfrog, s.20); acmeco CONFORMANT-PROJECTION; CC-ACMECO 1-11 saved (2 per-incuriam), CC-ACMECO 12 remitted (found SAVED: full court of 9, unanimous).

25.title: [2026] REALM-SC 8
25.ratio: Lexby (CASE-LAW s. 3) holds NO law-making or adjudicative drafting authority; the authoritative text of an instrument is the Committee's (drafting) + the Sovereign's (enactment), of a judgment the constituted bench's. Un-adopted Lexby instrument-text is VOID as an instrument on its own account (6-3); a Lexby-authored ratio that IS the decision is void ab initio under s. 18(5) (unanimous, applying [2026] REALM-SC 4). Remedy CURATIVE not destructive: the text leapfrogs as a void FIRST DRAFT into the Committee's second-draft stage (or the s. 18(4) registrar route for judgments), and ADOPTION by the proper organ is constitutive and CURES the origin defect (spent on adoption), so the enacted statute book (Bills 1-27), REALM-SI 1, and REALM-SC 1-7 / REALM-CA 1 / the Privy Council line STAND (entry-by-entry, non-infectious, conforming [2026] REALM-SC 7). Engineering is Lexby's, the test being the SOURCE OF THE ARTEFACT'S FORCE (function vs promulgation). The Court RULES the principle and DIRECTS the Standing Committee to draft a clarifying s. 3 limb; it does not legislate the text itself. Affirms [2026] REALM-PC 12.
